proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C p r s t hABC hprod h1 h2
  have hli : ∀ a b : ℝ, a • (B -ᵥ A) + b • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
    intro a b h
    by_contra hab
    apply hABC
    rcases not_and_or.mp hab with ha | hb
    · have hB : B -ᵥ A = (-b / a) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : a • (B -ᵥ A) = (-b) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-b / a) A C
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hB, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
    · have hC : C -ᵥ A = (-a / b) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : b • (C -ᵥ A) = (-a) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-a / b) A B
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hC, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm] at h4
  have hr1 : 1 - r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hprod; simp at hprod
  have hs1 : 1 - s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hprod; simp at hprod
  have ht1 : 1 - t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hprod; simp at hprod
  have H : r * s * t = (1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t) := by
    field_simp at hprod
    linear_combination hprod
  set u : V := B -ᵥ A with hu
  set w : V := C -ᵥ A with hw
  have hCB : C -ᵥ B = w - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
  have hAC : A -ᵥ C = -w := (neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A).symm
  have eD : AffineMap.lineMap B C r -ᵥ A = (1 - r) • u + r • w := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hCB, ← hu]; module
  have eE : AffineMap.lineMap C A s -ᵥ A = (1 - s) • w := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hAC, ← hw]; module
  have eF : AffineMap.lineMap A B t -ᵥ A = t • u := by
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_self, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp h2
  have p1 : p -ᵥ A = (x * (1 - r)) • u + (x * r) • w := by
    rw [← hx, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub, eD]; module
  have p2 : p -ᵥ A = (1 - y) • u + (y * (1 - s)) • w := by
    have eEB : AffineMap.lineMap C A s -ᵥ B = (1 - s) • w - u := by
      rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ B A, eE]
    rw [← hy, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, eEB, ← hu]; module
  have h0 : (x * (1 - r) - (1 - y)) • u + (x * r - y * (1 - s)) • w = (0 : V) := by
    have : ((x * (1 - r)) • u + (x * r) • w) - ((1 - y) • u + (y * (1 - s)) • w) = (0 : V) := by
      rw [← p1, ← p2, sub_self]
    rw [← this]; module
  obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hli _ _ h0
  set κ := r + (1 - r) * (1 - s) with hκ
  have hxκ : x * κ = 1 - s := by rw [hκ]; linear_combination e2 + (1 - s) * e1
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hxκ; exact hs1 hxκ.symm
  have key : t = x * (t * r + 1 - r) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hκ0
    rw [hκ] at hxκ ⊢
    linear_combination H - (t * r + 1 - r) * hxκ
  refine mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr ⟨1 - x * r, ?_⟩
  apply vsub_left_cancel (p := A)
  rw [p1, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, ← hw]
  have eFC : AffineMap.lineMap A B t -ᵥ C = t • u - w := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ C A, eF]
  rw [eFC]
  have c1 : (1 - x * r) * t = x * (1 - r) := by linear_combination key
  have : (1 - x * r) • (t • u - w) + w = ((1 - x * r) * t) • u + (x * r) • w := by module
  rw [this, c1]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C p : P) (r s t : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → r / (1 - r) * (s / (1 - s)) * (t / (1 - t)) = 1 → p ∈ line[ℝ, A, AffineMap.lineMap B C r] → p ∈ line[ℝ, B, AffineMap.lineMap C A s] → p ∈ line[ℝ, C, AffineMap.lineMap A B t]
